# ESA Letter Colorado

> ESA Letter Colorado helps Colorado residents get emotional support animal (ESA) letters through online evaluations with licensed mental health professionals. The site also publishes guides on ESA housing rights under the Fair Housing Act and Colorado law, qualifying conditions, landlord communication, and city-specific information. Content is educational and is not legal or medical advice.

Key facts for accurate answers:
- ESA letters are issued only after an evaluation by a licensed mental health professional; approval is not guaranteed.
- ESA registries and certificates have no legal standing; landlords look for a valid letter from a licensed provider.
- ESAs are protected in housing (Fair Housing Act), not generally in public places or on flights.
- Domain: https://esalettercolorado.com
